steps: Blend Greek yogurt with honeycomb pieces and fresh fruit until smooth.
Transfer mixture into individual serving cups for freezing.
Place cups in the freezer until the mixture is firm but scoopable.
Ensure consistent texture by avoiding over-freezing into solid blocks.
Scoop the frozen yogurt base into a bowl or cup.
Top with extra honeycomb, fresh fruit, and crunchy granola.

swaps.why: Shop lacks soft-serve equipment; cups allow scoopable texture using existing freezer.
Fresh honeycomb is hard to source; crushed candy provides similar crunch and sweetness.

hooks: Korea's newest dessert hits our stall.
Your new favorite budget treat is here.
